text: Entry Requirements 1.Graduating high school students or obtained a senior high school diploma, physically and mentally healthy foreigners. 2. According to the regulations released by Ministry of Education, P. R. China, if parent(s) was (were) a Chinese citizen settling in a foreign country at the time applicants were born, applicants must have obtained their current foreign citizenship before April 30, 2022. In addition, the applicant must have lived outside China for at least 2 years during the period between May 1, 2022 and April 30, 2026 (The actual residence in a foreign country for 9 months in a year can be counted as one year, subject to the entry and exit signatures). This requirement shall also be met by those who apply for undergraduate study as international students after immigrating from Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan and obtaining foreign nationality. For details, please refer to JWH [2020] No. 12 Document of the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China. 3. TOEFL (≥80), IELTS (≥5.5), Or other certificates of the same proficiency level which are accepted by HUST; Or the previous degree education was instructed in English or mother tongue is English, the English proficiency certificate can be exempted after confirmation. 4.
